app.name: Kadr

media.title: MEDIA
media.empty.title: No media yet

Import video, audio or images.
Source files are never modified.
media.bin_empty_hint: Right-click a clip in «All» → «Move to selected bin».
preview.title: PREVIEW
preview.empty.timeline: Add media to the timeline to see it here
preview.empty.offline: Media offline — the source file was moved or deleted
tl.tip.blade: Blade tool (B) — click a clip to cut
tl.tip.ripple: Ripple edits (R) — trims and deletes close gaps
tl.blade_hint: Blade: click a clip to cut · Esc to exit
tl.ctx.dissolve: Add cross dissolve at nearest cut
tl.empty.title: Your timeline is empty
tl.empty.hint: Drag clips here from Media, double-click a clip, or select it and press «,» (insert) / «.» (overwrite).
inspector.title: INSPECTOR
inspector.multi: {0} clips selected — select one clip to edit its properties
inspector.seq.format_hint: The format is taken from the first video clip placed on an empty timeline.
inspector.markers.empty: No markers. Press M to add one at the playhead.
inspector.tips.body: Click a clip to edit its transform, color and audio. Double-click a value to type it; double-click a slider to reset it. Press F1 for all shortcuts.
inspector.effects.empty: No effects. The effect library arrives in V0.3.
inspector.hint.values: Double-click a value to type an exact number.
ai.title: AI ASSISTANT
ai.empty.title: Edit with words
ai.empty.body: Simple commands run locally and for free. Anything else first shows the provider, model and estimated cost — nothing is sent without your OK.
ai.plan.range_proposal: Remove {d} with ripple on all unlocked tracks.
ai.pauses.title: Remove pauses
ai.pauses.nothing: Nothing to remove — no long pauses found.
ai.pauses.proposal.one: Remove {n} pause with ripple on all unlocked tracks (sync is preserved), keeping {pad} of air at each edge.
ai.pauses.proposal.other: Remove {n} pauses with ripple on all unlocked tracks (sync is preserved), keeping {pad} of air at each edge.
ai.offer.title: Cloud AI request
ai.offer.privacy_note: Only timeline structure and analysis text is sent — never video, frames or audio.
ai.offer.over_budget: Over the {limit} limit: spent {spent} + up to {est} > {max}
ai.msg.off: AI is turned off in settings. Editing works as usual.
ai.msg.analysis_pending.one: Audio analysis is still running for {n} file. Try again in a few seconds.
ai.msg.analysis_pending.other: Audio analysis is still running for {n} files. Try again in a few seconds.
ai.msg.no_audio: There is no audio on the timeline — nothing to search for pauses.
ai.msg.no_provider: I couldn't understand this locally, and no AI provider is configured for the {tier} level. Set one up in Settings → AI & Privacy.
ai.msg.nothing_here: Couldn't do it: there is nothing to change at this position.
ai.msg.plan_stale: This plan no longer fits the current timeline: {error}
ai.msg.applied: Done. New duration: {d}. To revert, press «Undo AI edit» or Ctrl+Z.
ai.msg.local_only_help: OK, local only. Available locally: «remove pauses longer than N seconds», «split here», «delete the last/first N seconds», «add marker …», «undo».
privacy.deny.off: AI is turned off in settings.
privacy.deny.local_only: «Local only» mode is on: cloud providers are disabled. Switch to «Ask before cloud processing» in AI settings to allow this request.
privacy.deny.kind.text: Sending text to this provider is not permitted.
privacy.deny.kind.images: Sending images to this provider is not permitted.
privacy.deny.kind.audio: Sending audio to this provider is not permitted.
privacy.deny.kind.video: Sending video to this provider is not permitted.
export.title: Export video
export.subtitle: H.264 / AAC · {0}
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: The interface switches instantly — no restart needed.
settings.autosave.hint: Autosave writes a separate recovery file. After a crash Kadr offers to restore it; your saved project is never overwritten.
settings.preview_quality.hint: Lower quality plays 4K and long-GOP footage more smoothly. Export always uses full quality.
settings.clear_cache.hint: The cache holds thumbnails, audio previews and analysis. It is rebuilt automatically; source media are never touched.
settings.mode.local.d: Local algorithms only. Nothing leaves this computer.
settings.mode.ask.d: Every cloud request first shows provider, model and cost.
settings.mode.allow.d: Allowed providers run within budget limits without asking.
settings.providers: PROVIDERS · keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager
settings.spent: Spent — session {session} ({tin} in / {tout} out tokens), project {project}, this month {month}
jobs.title: Background jobs
welcome.hint: Tip: drag media onto the timeline, press Space to play, S to split. F1 shows all shortcuts.
welcome.recent.none: No recent projects yet. Saved projects will appear here.
dlg.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
dlg.unsaved.body: The current project has unsaved changes. Discard them?
dlg.exit.title: Save changes?
dlg.exit.body: Save changes to the project before closing Kadr?
dlg.recover.title: Restore unsaved project?
dlg.recover.body: Kadr found an autosave of a project that was never saved — the previous session may have ended unexpectedly. Restore it?
dlg.clear_cache.title: Clear cache?
dlg.clear_cache.body: Thumbnails, audio previews and analysis results will be deleted and rebuilt when needed. Your projects and media are not affected.
dlg.remove_media.title: Remove media from project?
dlg.remove_media.body: «{name}» will be removed from the project. The file on disk is not deleted.
dlg.delete_bin.title: Delete bin?
dlg.delete_bin.body.one: Bin «{bin}» contains {n} item. It will be moved back to «All» — nothing is deleted.
dlg.delete_bin.body.other: Bin «{bin}» contains {n} items. They will be moved back to «All» — nothing is deleted.
dlg.rename_clip.title: Rename clip
dlg.rename_clip.label: Clip name
dlg.rename_marker.title: Rename marker
dlg.rename_marker.label: Marker name
dlg.rename_seq.title: Rename sequence
dlg.rename_seq.label: Sequence name
toast.recovered_autosave: Recovered unsaved changes from autosave — save the project to keep them
toast.restored: Project restored from autosave — save it to keep it
toast.media_offline.one: {n} media file is offline (moved or deleted)
toast.media_offline.other: {n} media files are offline (moved or deleted)
toast.export_running: An export is running — cancel it first or wait until it finishes
toast.export_failed: Export failed — see the Export window for details
toast.nothing_to_export: Nothing to export — the timeline is empty
toast.blade_on: Blade tool: click a clip to cut (B or Esc to exit)
toast.ripple_on: Ripple edits on: trims and deletes close gaps
toast.select_clips_to_delete: Select clips to delete (or set an In/Out range)
toast.select_media_first: Select a clip in Media first
toast.select_bin_first: Select a bin first (click it above the media list)
toast.media_in_use.one: This media is used by {n} clip on the timeline — remove the clip first
toast.media_in_use.other: This media is used by {n} clips on the timeline — remove them first
toast.dissolve_added: Cross dissolve added (shown on the timeline; rendering arrives with the effects engine)
toast.no_cut_near: No adjacent cut near the playhead
toast.newer_edits: There are newer edits — undo them first (Ctrl+Z)
toast.audio_not_ready.one: {n} audio clip is still being prepared — it will be silent this time
toast.audio_not_ready.other: {n} audio clips are still being prepared — they will be silent this time
toast.key_stored: API key for {provider} stored in Windows Credential Manager
toast.cache_busy: Background jobs are running — wait for them to finish before clearing the cache
toast.about: Kadr {version} — native AI-first video editor (Rust · Slint · FFmpeg)
err.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg was not found. Install FFmpeg (ffmpeg and ffprobe in PATH) — import and export are disabled until then.
err.video_tracks_locked: All video tracks are locked — unlock one first
err.audio_tracks_locked: All audio tracks are locked — unlock one first
err.project.too_new: This project was saved by a newer version of Kadr: {path}
err.project.corrupt: The project file is damaged and can't be read: {path}
err.export.offline.one: {n} media file is offline — relink or remove it before exporting
err.export.offline.other: {n} media files are offline — relink or remove them before exporting
err.edit.overlap: the change would overlap the next clip
err.edit.kind_mismatch: this media doesn't fit this track type
err.edit.track_not_empty: the track isn't empty — remove its clips first
err.edit.last_track: a sequence needs at least one video and one audio track
err.ai.no_key_for: no API key for {provider} — add it in Settings → AI & Privacy
err.ai.timeout: the provider didn't answer in time
err.ai.rate_limited: rate limited by the provider — try again in a minute
err.ai.auth: the API key was rejected — check it in Settings → AI & Privacy
drop.hint: Media files and folders are imported into the library; a .kadr file opens the project
toast.drop_skipped.one: {n} file skipped: not a supported media format
toast.drop_skipped.other: {n} files skipped: not a supported media format
toast.drop_project_only: A project was dropped together with media: the project is opened, the media is not imported
toast.drop_nothing: No media files found in the dropped folder
err.ai.too_large: The request is too large for one call
err.ai.unknown_model: The provider does not know this model: {model}
mc.dlg.title: New multicam group
mc.dlg.hint: Pick the clips filmed at the same time. Kadr syncs them by timecode or by sound. Say what each camera shows: the AI camera picks read it.
mc.dlg.edit_hint: Rename angles and describe what each camera shows: the AI camera picks read it.
mc.dlg.name: Name
mc.dlg.col.label: Angle
mc.dlg.labels_unique: Every angle needs its own non-empty name.
mc.dlg.audio_pending: Waiting for the audio analysis of: {names}. Try again in a moment.
mc.need_two_videos: Import at least two video clips to build a multicam group
mc.no_overlap: These clips don't overlap in time after sync
mc.toast.unsynced.one: Could not sync {names}: no timecode and no matching sound. It starts at offset 0.
mc.toast.unsynced.other: Could not sync {names}: no timecode and no matching sound. They start at offset 0.
inspector.shots.ungraded: Not graded yet. Ask the assistant: “grade shots”.
inspector.shots.hint: Click a verdict to correct it: Jev learns your taste from these corrections.
jev.no_key: No Jev API key: add it in Settings → AI
jev.card.cached: {n} of {total} answers come from the project cache (free)
jev.grade.nothing: No analysed shots yet: import video and wait for the picture analysis to finish.
jev.grade.done: Shot grading done: {bad} rejected, {review} to check. Verdicts are in the Inspector; the clips are only marked, nothing was deleted.
jev.cams.no_multicam: Put a multicam group on the timeline (or select its clip) first.
jev.cams.no_angles: No interval has two angles with media.
jev.cams.nothing_to_change: Jev agrees with the current cut: nothing to change.
jev.cams.findings: {n} intervals decided, {personal} of them from your past corrections.
jev.cams.why_personal: like your picks in similar moments
jev.cams.all_unsure: Jev couldn't choose a camera anywhere: it has too little to go on. Describe what each camera shows (right-click the group → Edit angles…), or switch angles by hand with keys 1–9: Jev learns from those picks.
jev.cams.agree_some_unsure: Nothing to change: where Jev was sure, it agrees with the current cut. In {n} intervals it couldn't choose — describe the cameras in the group to help it.
settings.jev_personalize_hint: When Jev picks cameras, your past corrections in similar moments are sent along as examples. They stay in the project file; turn this off to get Jev's general judgement only.
